Planning a visit to Japan?

Agha Travel & Tours helps Pakistani applicants navigate the temporary visitor visa process with practical guidance, accurate application preparation and documentation tailored to the purpose of travel.

Visa at a Glance

A Japanese single-entry temporary visitor visa is generally valid for around 3 months, with the authorized stay determined by the visa issued. Visa validity and permitted stay should not be confused.

Temporary Visitor VisaJapan · from Pakistan

What You Should Know

The essentials of the Japan Temporary Visitor Visa, before you start your file.

01

Who This Visa Is For

Tourism, family and friends visits and eligible business travel have different documentary requirements. Your stated travel purpose, daily itinerary and supporting evidence must agree.

02

Important Country-Specific Guidance

Applicants visiting relatives or friends may need an invitation, relationship evidence and supporting documents from Japan. Business visitors may need an invitation and details of the inviting company. There is no universal official PKR bank-balance threshold.

03

A Personalised Application, Not a Generic Checklist

Each application is assessed against the traveller’s actual circumstances. Our team helps you present relevant information clearly and consistently, rather than adding unnecessary paperwork or repeating documents that do not support your case.

Checklist

Documents You Should Prepare

A starting point for your Japan file. Our consultants tailor the final checklist to your travel purpose and profile.

Get My Checklist

Core documents

  • Valid Passport
  • CNIC, FRC and MRC (if married).
  • Last 3 months Bank statement.
  • Business or Employment details.

When visiting relatives, friends or for business

  • Host invitation
  • Proof of relationship
  • Your host’s status in Japan

Japan Visa Application

Practical steps, professional support and clear next actions.

01

How We Help You Apply

Our team helps structure the itinerary, review your financial and occupational profile, organize host or business documents and prepare a coherent application.

02

Application & Submission Process

Submission requirements, fees and application channels depend on the current Japanese mission and authorized application arrangements in Pakistan. These should be verified before submitting.

03

Before You Make Travel Plans

Japanese authorities may request additional documentation. No invitation or previous travel history guarantees approval.
